name: Nearby-Bitcoin map copes with location access denied
description: The 'Bitcoin Near You' card works normally when location access is allowed. When access is turned off, the card still shows (falling back to a default area) instead of crashing or nagging with prompts, and it recovers as soon as access is granted again.
details: Fresh wallet with the harness install-time location grant: the Bitcoin Near You card's probe reads granted. Revoke the location TCC record and relaunch: the card must still render (London default region — no crash, no blank card, no prompt loop) with the probe reading denied — the request was really made and really refused. Grant + relaunch recovers to granted. The denial path is deliberately silent in-product; the new wallet-location AX probe is the only observable seam
